I've created the offer letter for the Senior Software Engineer position and saved it to `offer-letter-senior-software-engineer.md`. Here's the full draft:

# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [COMPANY NAME]. We believe your skills and experience will be valuable additions to our team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [Engineering Manager Name/Title]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly], subject to applicable withholdings.

**Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus eligibility requires active employment at the time of payment and is subject to company policy.

**Equity:** [X shares of stock options vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, subject to the terms of a separate Stock Option Agreement / Not applicable]

**Sign-On Bonus:** [Optional: $[AMOUNT], subject to repayment if employment ends voluntarily within [X] months / Not applicable]

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:
- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- [Remote work stipend / Learning and development budget / Other benefits]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Notes:**
- This draft follows the standard offer letter template from the skill. It uses standard, legally sound provisions only — it intentionally does **not** include restrictive clauses like non-competes in an offer letter (those belong in a separate, jurisdiction-specific agreement if applicable), provisions barring reporting of unlawful activity, or salary deductions tied to company losses, as those would be inappropriate and generally unenforceable.
- Placeholders in `[brackets]` should be filled in with your specific details.
- As with all employment documents, this is a template for informational purposes and not legal advice — have it reviewed by qualified legal counsel before use.

Would you like me to also draft the accompanying Confidentiality Agreement or Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement referenced in the contingencies section?
